subject: Re: KNF status: repro complete, feedback-loop latency trade-off
body:
Fumiko, Bao,

Decision from Tuesday's review, writing it down so it sticks:

1. We ship the two-tier story. Tier 1 "shift-robust batch" is the flagship: full feedback loop, daily/weekly cadence, aimed at demand planning and risk teams. Tier 2 "low-latency" uses frozen operators with a documented robustness caveat and a scheduled re-fit. We will not market a single config that claims both.

2. The shift-injection eval Bilal built becomes part of the memo's evidence base - the 14% MAE degradation gap between tiers under injected shifts is the clearest single number we have, keep it front and center.

3. Q3 scale-up plan goes in the May 1 memo as planned, sized to the funding Bao lined up. Giannis, please add the multi-seed variance runs before we freeze numbers - I don't want single-seed results in a trust-portfolio memo.

Nice work all.

Ximena
